summary:
Implemented unknown-total (None) Progress tasks. Changes are in rich/progress.py, rich/progress_bar.py, docs/source/progress.rst, tests/test_progress.py, and tests/test_bar.py. Nothing is committed.

What works: an unknown-total task pulses at full width with no percentage or ETA text. Blank and "?" placeholders appear in the size, count, and download columns, and binary units are chosen from completed. update and advance never set finished time or speed for unknown totals. TaskProgressColumn is public and importable from rich.progress.

Test results: tests/test_progress.py and tests/test_bar.py pass (52 tests). The full suite run excluding tests/test_pretty.py gives 592 passed and 13 failed. An export of untouched HEAD gives the same 13 failures in card, markdown, syntax, and traceback tests, so they predate this change. tests/test_pretty.py cannot be collected because the shared venv lacks the attr package; I did not install it.

Not verified: black is not in the shared venv, so formatting was checked by hand. Some long docstring lines remain, matching the file's existing style.

Notes: tests/test_progress.py changed on disk during the work. I kept its contents and only reformatted one over-long line in my own test. An early edit landed in advance() instead of update(); I repaired the indent and both finish blocks now carry the total-is-not-None guard.
